evidence.reason: The switch performs point-in-time inactive(root) checks at lines 839 and 841, then mutates the checkout and config while holding tick_lock. tick_lock serializes helper operations, not systemd start/timer dispatch, so a start accepted after the final check can run during git restore/checkout or the atomic config write against a half-switched tree. The code's intended inactive-before-mutation invariant is therefore racy; an activation barrier must span the full mutation window, and another list-jobs snapshot would not close it.
